powers: When you play a card that has the Firearm trait, if you would bury (☐ or discard)(☐ or recharge) it or shuffle it into your deck, you may keep it and perform the required action with another card instead.

When you encounter a monster, you may examine the top card of your deck. If it has the Firearm trait, you may draw it; otherwise, recharge it. (☐ You may then recharge a card that has the Firearm trait from your discard pile.)

roles.name: Alkenstar Marshal
powers: When you play a card that has the Firearm trait, if you would bury (☐ or discard)(☐ or recharge) it or shuffle it into your deck, you may keep it and perform the required action with another card instead.

When you encounter a monster, you may examine the top card of your deck. If it has the Firearm trait, you may draw it; otherwise, recharge it. (☐ You may then recharge a card that has the Firearm trait from your discard pile.) (☐ You may then recharge a card to draw a card.)
☐ Add 1d6 (☐ 2d6) to your check to acquire or recharge an item or a weapon.
☐ You may bury a weapon or an item (☐ or any boon) to recharge a card that has the Firearm trait from your discard pile.
☐ When you would recharge a card that has the Firearm trait, you may instead shuffle it into your deck.
☐ Treat your character powers that say "Firearm" as if they say "Ammunition or Firearm."

roles.name: Mysterious Stranger
powers: When you play a card that has the Firearm trait, if you would bury (☐ or discard)(☐ or recharge) it or shuffle it into your deck, you may keep it and perform the required action with another card instead.

When you encounter a monster, you may examine the top card of your deck. If it has the Firearm trait, you may draw it; otherwise, recharge it. (☐ You may then recharge a card that has the Firearm trait from your discard pile.)
☐ At the end of your turn (☐ or when your location is close), you may move to a random open location; if you do, you may examine the top card of its location deck (☐ and you may shuffle that deck).
☐ You may use your Ranged skill instead of your Diplomacy skill. (☐ When you would discard an ally that lists Diplomacy in its check to acquire for its power, you may recharge it instead.)
☐ When the result of your check equals its difficulty, you may recharge a random card from your discard pile (☐ and you may draw a card).
